verdict.rationale: RudderStack's Profiles product documents warehouse-based identity resolution via declarative, version-controlled YAML that 'handles identity resolution' and can 'generate identity graphs from any combination of unique identifiers across any number of data sources,' which implies cross-device/anonymous+known stitching into a customer 360. However, evidence never explicitly details how anonymous vs. known identity merging is configured (e.g., ID merge rules, alias/identify calls) and there's no independent/hands-on validation of stitching accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of anonymous-to-known identity merge rules/configuration options, and independent or hands-on confirmation the stitching works as claimed.
